notes_for_editor: All four sources are lookout-site lists; the two Idaho pages and the county list agree on 1929 and 1965, but they are not independent of each other and no primary record was found. Two web searches did not confirm the site. Confusion risk: Cottonwood Butte is a different lookout, and its Idaho Fire Lookouts page (Payette/Salmon NF, 9349 ft) also gives a 1920s log cabin and 1965 destroyed; the 1965 date should not be carried over without a source for this site. Record kind 'ground' fits the FFLA 'Ground Gone' entry. The coordinates (45.91852, -116.6617) fit '24 miles west of Grangeville', but were not checked against 30N-3W-23. The 'Private' access level is from the listings only; no visit rules were found.
